race.comment: CONCRETE STORM (12) bounced off his fighting first-up third, with a sharp Maiden victory over 1400m at Newcastle. Gets a similar set-up for this with Zac Lloyd taking the reins. No surprise to see him make it two on the trot. DIVINE SECRETS (9) caught the eye first up at Newcastle over the 1250m. Started a dominant $2 fav when slipped at the start from the outside gate to finish a below-par eighth over 1350m at Beaumont (Newcastle). Finds a nice race from a better gate and set to atone. STALLONE (3) has gone to a new level this prep and maps to get the gun run again. Stuck on well when second over 1350m at Beaumont (Newcastle) after showing good early speed. Worthy contender. CALTSAR (1) returns from a lengthy break. Poorly drawn and far from disgraced when eighth over 1400m at Kembla Grange in the Provincial Mid Champs over 1400m last March. Fitted with the two trials and undefeated first up.
